 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Make a 2x2 arrangement of the grid's four quarter-turn orientations."""
    n = len(grid)
    out = [[0] * (2 * n) for _ in range(2 * n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            v = grid[r][c]
            out[r][c] = v                              # original
            out[c][2 * n - 1 - r] = v                 # 90 degrees clockwise
            out[2 * n - 1 - c][r] = v                 # 90 degrees counterclockwise
            out[2 * n - 1 - r][2 * n - 1 - c] = v    # 180 degrees
    return out
"
